tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Shop metadata, plan, credit balance and dailyCap {used, limit, resetsAt} (the rolling 24-hour API credit cap) for this API key. Free; call before spending credits.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Catalog of accepted generation options (currently the output tiers). Free.

tools.name: create_photoshoot_batch
tools.description: COSTS MONEY: every successful submission spends real, paid credits from the account's SocialShot balance (about credits_estimated in the result; higher tier / output_quality cost more). Only call it when the user has asked for images to be generated, and check get_account (credits, dailyCap) first.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a photoshoot batch: per-item status and output_url. The batch is done when `settled` >= `expected_total`. `total` only counts rows written so far, so it can lag while the queue drains.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Poll a batch (backoff 2s up to 10s) until every item is completed or failed, or until timeout. Pass expected_total (the `total` from create_photoshoot_batch) until the server reports its own. On timeout returns done=false with the latest status; call again to keep waiting.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_photoshoot_batch" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
